summary: Example options block setting dumb-init as entrypoint, csh as cmd, microdnf as package manager, skip_ansible_check true, a custom workdir and user.
questions: How do I use dumb-init in an execution environment?
Set a custom workdir and user in ansible-builder

answer_card.title: ansible-builder options example
answer_card.answer_md:
```
options:
  container_init:
    package_pip: dumb-init>=1.2.5
    entrypoint: '["dumb-init"]'
    cmd: '["csh"]'
  package_manager_path: /usr/bin/microdnf
  relax_passwd_permissions: false
  skip_ansible_check: true
  workdir: /myworkdir
  user: bob
```
